build_maskformer_detector: build a MaskFormer detector with backbone, panoptic head, and panoptic fusion head configs
run_maskformer_loss: run the MaskFormer loss computation on batched input images and ground truth data samples
run_maskformer_predict: run MaskFormer prediction on input images to get panoptic and instance segmentation results
review_maskformer_forward: review the MaskFormer _forward method that extracts features and runs panoptic head forward pass
refactor_maskformer_add_pred: refactor the MaskFormer add_pred_to_datasample method to attach predictions to DetDataSample objects
